description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for user profiles within a C# ASP.NET Core project. It includes a request query, a validator for the query, and a handler that reads profile data using an injected profile reader.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents a request to fetch profile details for a specific username.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the profile details request by reading profile data through the injected profile reader.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the profile details request, calling profileReader.ReadProfile with the username.
